:::{#def-lower-upper-limits}
#### Lower and upper limits of a sum or integral

In a [sum](algebra.qmd#def-summation) $\sum_{i=m}^{n} a_i$,
the **lower limit** $m$ is the first value of the index $i$,
and the **upper limit** $n$ is its last value.
In an [integral](calculus.qmd#def-riemann-integral) $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx$,
the **lower limit** $a$ is the left end of the interval of integration,
and the **upper limit** $b$ is its right end;
together they are the **limits of integration**.
In both, the lower limit is written below the symbol
and the upper limit above it.

:::
